`class StringSignal`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Signal<String>`](/reference/signals/signal/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.signal.impl.primitive` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [StringSignal.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/signal/impl/primitive/StringSignal.java)

Signal of a `String` with the text operations of `String`, which write their result.

## Description

It works like [`Signal`](/reference/signals/signal/); each operation applies the method of the same name of `String` to the value and writes the result.
An index outside the text throws a `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` when the write applies.
